title: Credential stored in user defaults (swift)
description: swift code stores a value in the user-defaults store (UserDefaults.standard.set). That store is a plist inside the app container: it is not encrypted at rest, it is copied into backups and it is readable on a jailbroken device or from a filesystem image. This lexical rule flags the write; the reviewer confirms the value is not a credential.
remediation: Store tokens and passwords in the Keychain with an appropriate accessibility class, for example Keychain with a device-only accessibility class, and keep user defaults for preferences only.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags every write to the defaults store, including harmless preferences.
